add_or_replace_emt_model_connected(device: Any, emt_model: Block, side: EmtBusConnectionSide, device_tpe: DeviceType) → None[source]

Add or replace one connected EMT endpoint in the bus-local registry.

The registry key is the pair (device, side) because one device can only expose one endpoint per bus side. When the same device assigns a new EMT model block, the existing record must be replaced instead of appended.

Parameters:

  • device – Owning device of the EMT model.

  • emt_model – EMT model block connected to this bus.

  • side – Semantic side of the connection relative to this bus.

  • device_tpe – Device type used for later reconnect dispatch.

Returns:

None.

class VeraGridEngine.Devices.Parents.dynamic_bus_parent.EmtBusConnectedModelRecord(device: Any, model: Block, side: EmtBusConnectionSide, device_tpe: DeviceType)[source]

Bases: object

Store one materialized EMT model endpoint connected to one bus.

The bus EMT shell can be recreated when the required phase layout expands. When that happens, the bus must reconnect every already-connected EMT model using the correct side-specific helper. This light record stores the exact metadata needed for that deterministic rebinding.

Parameters:

  • device – Owning device of the EMT model.

  • model – Materialized EMT model block.

  • side – Semantic side by which the model is attached to the bus.

  • device_tpe – Device type used to select the proper reconnect helper.

model – New materialized EMT model block.

None.

class VeraGridEngine.Devices.Parents.dynamic_bus_parent.EmtBusConnectionSide(*values)[source]

Bases: Enum

Enumerate the semantic side by which one EMT model is attached to one bus.

The bus-local reconnect algorithm must know whether one device consumes the bus shell as a single-bus injection, a branch from terminal, or a branch to terminal. Using one enum keeps the registry explicit and refactorable.

Returns:

None.

BUS = 'bus'
FROM = 'from'
TO = 'to'
